quotes.text: // If this fails, just continue, we'll still want to remove the password

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The native loop ignored an individual removal failure and still cleared its cache. The JS port keeps the continue-and-clear comment but awaits each removeLoginAsync without a local catch. A rejection exits before the later cache clear. The accepted exact snapshot still has that ordering and comment, so settlement waiting does not implement the promised continuation. No failure or stored-password state was exercised.
title: Password forgetting can reject before the cache-clearing promise in its comment
